verdict.rationale: Pulley's docs show the cap table covers every element of the story: share class configuration, customizable stock certificates, contract-specific tabs for SAFEs, RSAs, RSUs and convertible notes, option templates and equity plan capacity. It also keeps complete cap table history, exports as of any date, acts as a registered transfer agent and handles ASC 718 compliance, which supports its role as a live system of record. The 'Excel as source of truth' note applies only to migration. Missing for 10: direct evidence of investor or auditor access to the cap table, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
